paper_title: 1+12 Can Large Language Models Serve as Cross-Lingual Knowledge   Aggregators
caption: Statistics of the dataset in our experiments.
model_annotation: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of the dataset used in the experiments, divided into five distinct categories. The largest segment, colored red, represents TriviaQA, accounting for 46% of the dataset (1829 instances). The second largest segment, in green, corresponds to HalluEval, making up 18% (721 instances). The purple segment denotes WebQA, comprising 25% (997 instances). A smaller yellow segment indicates the Chinese Domain, contributing 6% (231 instances). The smallest segment, in light blue, represents HalluQA, which accounts for 5% (185 instances). The chart uses a 3D effect with each slice slightly offset, and labels are placed outside the chart with lines pointing to the respective segments. Percentages and exact counts are provided for each category, and the segments are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top-right.
